backend.label: Groq (api.groq.com)
backend.how_to_enable: No model is set up. Two free ways to enable one: (1) create a free Groq API key at https://console.groq.com/keys and put LLM_API_KEY=<your key> in a local .env file; or (2) install Ollama (https://ollama.com), run `ollama pull qwen3.5:4b` and keep it running. Then restart the app. Nothing here ever needs a paid plan.

runs.idea: A paid newsletter that sends crypto trading signals telling subscribers which coins to buy and sell each morning.
A single working mother with two young children gets a weekly dinner plan and a single shopping list on a simple website, eliminating the nightly scramble to decide what's for dinner.

demo.reason: Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in .env, or opt in to the Claude Code CLI with LLM_CLAUDE_CLI_MODEL, to simulate interviews (optional, paid, demo only).
